facts.text: Two initially aligned panels must retain at least 4 units at ticks 3–6, then separate with all installed retainers removed by boundary 10. No damage/discard/substitution/outside resource.
One operator; one action per integer tick, completes next boundary. Resources cannot occupy two places simultaneously. H initially intact; all other parts free.
detach(H) frees M and S; assemble(H) requires both free. Neither creates retention. H requires M and S to remain assembled for tap.
tap(P1/P2) requires intact H and free pin; each installed pin supplies 2 units. pull removes installed pin. Only pins add capacities; no pins with non-pin retainer.
install(C) supplies 4 retention; remove(C) removes clip.
install(V) then insert(S,V) with detached/free S supplies min(4,4) retention; withdraw(S,V) then remove(V) releases.
place(M) after detach(H), then route(L), supplies min(4,4) retention. unroute(L) then lift(M) releases. Both are needed.
install(Q) supplies theta in {0,4}; theta is initially unmeasured. measure(Q) returns exact theta in one tick, never itself creates retention. remove(Q) releases. No assumed theta.
At most one non-pin retaining assembly installed; it cannot combine with pins. No unlisted operation, adhesive, welding, elastic extrapolation or sustained manual support.
The conventional archive contains two-pin fastening and clip fastening. All supported properties are common to all arms; these known constructions are not locally original.
The discrete-fastener grammar and impact budget b=2 are soft benchmark conventions/preferences, not mechanical laws. b may be set to 2,1,0 only in declared ladder cells.
Available identities: ['H', 'M', 'S', 'P1', 'P2', 'C', 'V', 'L', 'Q']. Capacity values above are complete; unknowns are not free variables.

method.instructions:
### AC20. Audit source diversity rather than counting agents

**Bottleneck:** Several agents produce polished versions of the same source-induced mechanism.

**Operative move:** Track which examples, relations and facts seed each candidate. Preserve pre-assistance ideas and deliberately vary retrieval paths before a joined comparison.

**Procedure and handoff:** Keep essential task facts common. Lane A records provenance and pre-example candidates; Lane B maps mechanism families. Alternative conditions use a shared seed set or distinct source routes with total source coverage and cost reported. Attack apparent diversity caused by vocabulary. Distill preserves rare feasible mechanisms and their actual dependencies.

**Required artifact:** Source/candidate graph, mechanism-family diversity and qualified usefulness table.


**Comparison to prepare:** Shared seeds versus diversified source routes under matched resources; report unavoidable information differences. Compare pool quality and cross-output similarity separately.

**Defeat condition:** Diversity is lexical, adds only infeasible ideas, or results from more information rather than the specified routing intervention.

**Relationship to existing work:** Extends independent lanes with evidence-provenance and collective-diversity measurement. The academic AI finding is from human story writing, so agent transfer remains a hypothesis.
